title: Long time strong Sobolev instability for quasilinear NLS
summary: We prove long-time strong Sobolev instability for a class of quasilinear Schrödinger equations on $\mathbb T^2$ arising, via the Madelung transform, in the description of Euler-Korteweg capillary fluids. More precisely, for every $s\ge 7$, arbitrarily small $μ>0$, and arbitrarily large $\mathcal K>0$, we construct a solution such that $$ \|u(0)\|_{H^s} \mathcal K $$ at some finite time $T$, for which we provide an explicit exponential upper bound.
